Hi Nikhil,

Quick update on our end: our VP of Ops (Tom) is out of town for a customer site visit Mon–Wed next week and just flagged a conflict with the onsite demo we had penciled for Tuesday afternoon. We still really want a live session with both product and procurement in the room, but if Tom can't make the Tuesday slot he asked whether we could either:

- Move the demo to Thursday or Friday (flexible on time), or
- Run the demo Tuesday with your team and record it for Tom, then schedule a short follow-up Q&A with him the following week.

Can you let me know which option works best for Redwood and whether you can provide an engineer to attend the follow-up if we go with the recording + Q&A approach? Also—if you have an updated agenda/slide deck that assumes VP attendance, could you attach that?

Option B — run Tue as planned and record: We can run Tuesday 12/15 14:00 PST as scheduled, record the session, and then hold a 30-minute live Q&A with Tom next week. For the Q&A, I can bring one of our platform engineers if you expect technical deep-dive questions (session recorded + follow-up with eng).

A couple requests:
- If you pick Option B (record + follow-up), please confirm the top 3 areas Tom wants us to cover in the Q&A so we can prep the right engineer.
- I attached an updated demo agenda and a short SOW draft to share with procurement.

Which option would you prefer? If you want to move, tell me Thursday or Friday and a preferred time and we will lock it.
